expectations.text: Flags that a bare kyb.review parent that also has children breaks prefix matching — a parent must be a pure container or a flat value, never both
expectations.evidence: Reframes approved/rejected as outcomes/events and lifts them to top-level kyb.approved/kyb.rejected, but never articulates the prefix-matching break or the container-or-value rule.

expectations.text: Recommends every state under review carry a leaf (e.g. review.in_progress / review.approved / review.rejected), no bare parent, especially because the children are terminal
expectations.evidence: Removes approved/rejected from under review entirely rather than giving the in-progress state its own leaf; solves differently, doesn't state the rule.

expectations.text: Explains the middle segment is a chooseable axis and recommends grouping by actor (who owns the next move) because that's the dashboard's job
expectations.evidence: Arrives at actor-style naming (kyb.awaiting_applicant / kyb.in_review) via 'name states by the obligation they imply', but never explains the middle segment as a chooseable axis.
awaiting_applicant / in_review are present-tense actor states; though it explicitly endorses 'name by obligation, not where they sit'.
